verdict.rationale: Stagehand's browser configuration docs say Browserbase runs browsers in four regions, so session data can be kept in a required jurisdiction. Stagehand can also launch or attach to a local browser, which keeps browser data on the user's own machine. Region choice is tied to the Browserbase cloud and backed by a single line of documentation. Stagehand also caches act/observe/extract results server-side with no stated residency, so not all data is covered. missing for 10: region list and selection details, residency guarantees for server-side cache and LLM-processed data, independent or hands-on corroboration.
